# SiteCMD Fix Brief: Example finding

Attempt: 42 | Check: `code_scan.example` | Severity: high | Site: https://example.com

## What is wrong

Example description

## Where to look

SiteCMD has no exact file mapping for this issue. Search the repository for where this behavior is configured and apply the fix there.

## Acceptance criteria

SiteCMD accepts the fix only once visitors' page loads under a build of the commit that carries the fix no longer raise the `code_scan.example` finding. A clean audit does not count. Make the smallest change that fixes the reported risk.

## When you are done

Ship the fix to production first. SiteCMD then verifies it only by watching visitors' page loads under a build of the commit that carries the fix, never from a clean audit. Call the SiteCMD MCP tool `request_verification` with attempt_id=42 when that is done. Do not mark the issue fixed yourself.
